input_transform: reuse v1 sampled XYZ, float64 centroid/max Euclidean radius, normalize then float32; no GT input

output_contract.sparse_copy_source_indices: saved reference FPS indices of same input
output_contract.provenance: defined by original forward concatenation; numerical coincidence does not relabel generated points

operators.FPS: audited Pointnet2 start 0, mag > 1e-3, temp 1e10, per-thread strict comparisons and halving reduction; CPU float32 arithmetic
operators.KNN: CPU float32 direct squared Euclidean distances, stable reference-index tie order, square-root distance output; native source currently unavailable

controls: 408-tensor exact schema/strict loading and loaded-value equality each process
bit-exact copied suffixes and source indices
bit-exact arrays across two independent CPU processes
diagnostics: generated unique support and exact input coincidences without a minimum-success threshold
all 8192 supplied GT rows and unique-support count, after prediction only
gt_sampling: No GT sampling/deduplication in this readiness task. Any later distance analysis must predeclare row-weighted and unique-support diagnostics separately, use the same partial transform, and retain the four-case denominator.
exclusions: no reconstruction quality cutoff or aggregate success metric
no physical unit, camera/ray, robot benefit/harm or novelty claim

failure_rules.hash_or_global_load_error: stop; preserve logs and files, no alternative weight or case substitution
failure_rules.timeout_or_oom: stop bounded execution and refine runtime; do not rerun by raising caps automatically
failure_rules.case_or_repeat_control_failure: REFINE_REFERENCE_OUTPUT; retain all four cases, diagnose before revision
failure_rules.all_controls_pass: REFERENCE_OUTPUT_VERIFIED_NATIVE_AND_PHYSICAL_UNRESOLVED; assess native parity/physical linkage before paper or hypothesis escalation
